description: Header file defining the AudioHardware class and related classes for Android audio hardware abstraction, including input/output stream classes, buffer management, and configuration constants.

classes.name: AudioHardware
classes.description: Main class managing audio hardware, streams, and configurations.

classes.name: AudioStreamOutALSA
classes.description: Handles audio output stream via ALSA.

classes.name: AudioStreamInALSA
classes.description: Handles audio input stream via ALSA.

classes.name: BufferProvider
classes.description: Interface for buffer management during audio processing.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Configures the audio output stream parameters.

methods.name: sampleRate
methods.description: Returns the sample rate of the audio stream.

methods.name: bufferSize
methods.description: Returns the buffer size in frames.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes audio data to the output stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads audio data from the input stream.
